name: Galleonaire
description: Take on Galleonaire on iPhone and Apple Watch. Answer fifteen increasingly difficult questions for a fictional million-galleon prize. Explore 450 questions about Harry Potter books, films and the wider wizarding world, with thirty questions at every prize level. Correct answers move straight to the next question, with no confirmation or Next Question button. Use Fifty-Fifty, Ask the Audience and Swap Question, protect guaranteed prizes, or walk away with your winnings. Enjoy original magical-library artwork, dramatic game-over music and a celebratory million-galleon fanfare. Both devices support independent offline games, a saved highest prize, native VoiceOver controls, adjustable original music, sound effects and haptics. Every fresh launch opens the main menu without restoring an unfinished game. Independent fan-made quiz, not affiliated with or endorsed by the authors, publishers or film studios referenced. Galleons are fictional points with no monetary value. No advertising or analytics.
whatToTest: 150 additional questions: exactly ten new questions at each of fifteen levels, bringing the bank to 450. Repeated or ambiguous older questions have also been replaced or clarified. Answer correctly and the next question appears immediately, without pressing Next or waiting for a timer. VoiceOver should focus the new question and read the previous correct answer and explanation before the new question. A wrong answer ends the game and reports the question reached, winnings reached and guaranteed amount retained. Listen to the more dramatic loss cue and extended million-galleon celebration, also available as individual Settings previews. Check the new original magical quiz chamber artwork, readable answer buttons, prize progress and larger-text layouts. Main Menu must work after losing, winning or walking away. A fresh launch discards unfinished progress but retains your highest prize and settings. Test all three lifelines, both 0-100 percent volume controls, phone and Watch audio interruptions, and paired settings sync. Physical VoiceOver and speaker testing remains important. Please report any question error with its wording and source note.
reviewNotes: No account, password, purchase, advertising or external service is needed to play. Start with New Game. The Watch app is embedded in the iPhone build and is playable independently. In-game galleons are fictional score points, not money, gambling or redeemable prizes. The app does not request Health, contacts, location, microphone or tracking access. Review both visual and native VoiceOver gameplay. The expanded question bank contains independently written trivia with source notes. Artwork and audio are original and the app makes no claim of official franchise affiliation.
